expected_outcomes: Every material responsibility has explicit authoritative ownership.
required_actions: Separate responsibilities only where they solve a defined problem.
expected_documents: Context, data flow, contracts, failure table, and ownership map.
acceptance: Trust boundaries, failures, and rollback are testable.
verification: Architecture, contract, failure, and operational review.
evidence: Diagrams, ADRs, contracts, and test results.
exceptions: Record boundary debt, trigger, owner, and review date.
